blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Diocese of Kalibo in Aklan has raised concerns over the recent opening of a casino in Boracay as it reiterated its opposition to gambling and its implications to the lives of many Filipinos. The opposition was made after a six-story casino hub opened at Station 0 in Barangay Yapak, Boracay Island. The diocese said does not want to promote hostility towards anyone, but to uphold the dignity of every individual, particularly the welfare of families.
